Does ai\_licia use any user data for training its AI models?

No, ai\_licia does not use personal data collected from users for training its AI models. Any data used for improving ai\_licia’s capabilities is public data from the Platforms where ai\_licia operates.

Can users opt out of data collection or specific AI functionalities?

Yes, users can opt out of data collection processes. However this will prevent them to interact with ai\_licia. Community leaders can manage these users through the dashboard, and any users can request data deletion through our website.

How can users provide feedback or report issues with ai\_licia?

Users can provide feedback or report issues in our Discord community. We value user input and strive to address any concerns promptly. [...] ai\_licia is more than just a Twitch Chat AI bot! Cross-platform long-term memory allows ai\_licia to retain context and recall key details, making every interaction feel personal and engaging. Game integrations: Enhance your gameplay streams with support for titles like League of Legends and Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020, with more integrations coming soon! Seamless integration: Use our public API to easily connect ai\_licia [...] If you followed all of our instructions but your Custom Name is not posting messages, it is related to extra restrictions you have set for your chat. It can be:The account needs to have a verified phone number to chatThe account needs to have a verified emailThe account needs to manually accepts chats rules before chattingTry to write manually with the account in your Chat to find what the issue is and fix it.

Is ai\_licia a Free AI Chatbot for Twitch?

You can try ai\_licia for free! After signing up, you can claim 3 streams for free, to try out all ai\_licia features. After these 3 streams, if you want to keep using ai\_licia, you will need to take a paid subscription.
